statement: A technical checkpoint of the faculty trajectory review. It is not a clinical validation, an approval of version 1, a consciousness authority, a resident deployment, a production authority or the start of any further phase.

ARTIFACT_LINKAGE.what: one create-only record links reviewer (opaque), scenario, package, artifact, grant, snapshot, review set, item, comparator, blind answers, reveal and post-reveal answers; submit is one critical section

AUTOSAVE.what: each answer is saved as it is given by a callback of the widget the reviewer changed; a refresh restores; a refused comment is said to be unsaved; a disk error is a refusal, never a traceback

BLINDED_REVIEW_FLOW.what: one page per scenario: context, timeline, chart, Q1-Q5 (+Q5H where the experiment stopped), one lock; no comparator, legacy number or identifier reaches the browser before the lock

COMPARATOR_REVEAL.what: the legacy comparator exists only for a LOCKED state, is overlaid on the same axes, is labelled nonauthoritative and is never called truth

FACULTY_ISOLATION.what: only inside the faculty review launcher of a process that named the review mode and passed its gate; the review modules import nothing of the engine, the authority, the shadow, the grant or the core

FIRST_PASS_IMMUTABILITY.what: the writer refuses and the reader ignores any change after the lock, a forged chained lock cannot reveal anything, a stale second tab changes nothing

RESIDENT_ISOLATION.what: a resident account or an ordinary deployment sees nothing of the review and nothing is created for them

SCENARIO_NAVIGATION.what: submit moves to the next scenario by itself; a scenario out of turn cannot be entered; a failed submit does not advance; submitted scenarios are read-only; each optional scenario opens by itself

SESSION_SUMMARY.what: N/N, the four judgment counts and the comments, from records that VERIFY against the log that closed them; an altered, foreign or missing record is not counted and is reported; the technical summary is written by itself

unchanged.p3_300_checkpoint_record: byte-identical (the launcher module gains no import: the page is handed in by app.py)

verdict_enables: a first human faculty use of the trajectory review in the controlled development environment, and nothing else; not a clinical validation, not a resident pilot, not an authority expansion
